citation.title: Prolonged fasting-induced metabolic signatures in human skeletal muscle of lean and obese men

population.description: Eighteen apparently healthy young men aged 20 to 35 y (enrolment), nine lean (BMI 19-23) and nine obese (BMI 32-40 kg/m2), low physical activity, non-smokers, no prescription medication. Age is printed as median (range) (lean 24 (21-33), obese 24 (21-35), Table 1), so mean and SD are null; top-level min/max are the observed range of all 18 and each protocol carries its own group's observed range. Each protocol carries its group's BMI mean +/- SD from Table 1 (lean 21.4 +/- 1.1, obese 35.7 +/- 2.6). The paper calls the cohort apparently healthy, with a medical examination and routine blood chemistry, and HbA1c normal in all (25-36 mmol/mol); the lean group is entered healthy, the obese group unselected, with its BMI (no glucose-tolerance test).

protocols.name: lean_fast12h
protocols.description: lean men, water only, nothing infused that the model reads before the clamp (t = 240); the arm starts 30 min before the paper's t = 0, so paper t = arm minute - 30; paper t = 0 is taken as the stated 12 h of fasting, so the arm starts after 11.5 h (arithmetic: 12 h - 0.5 h); read at paper t = 0 (arm minute 30), t = 60 (minute 90) and the mean of t = 210-240 (minutes 240-270, before the insulin clamp that starts at t = 240); clock hour of t = 0 not printed (08:00 assumed, so the arm starts 07:30)
